changes: pads: none → pads (groove_mm 0, lip_mm 0, pad_angle_deg 20, pad_tpu_mm 2, reach_mm 0, width_mm 12)
why: Iteration 1 showed pad_angle 30 gains gelatin but flips small-object faces to about -22 deg (large_marker squeezed_up_out; dice, wood_block, racquetball lost), and 45 lost 12 groups. Using the brief's numbers (pad_angle 0 adds ~6 deg; each deg of pad angle removes ~1 deg), pad_angle 20 should leave gelatin at ~30 deg, held with TPU friction 0.9 (tan 30 = 0.58), and small objects at -8 to -13 deg (tan < 0.25), well inside the friction of any contact. I drop the lip, which hooked or pressed in earlier trials, keep the default 12 mm width (the narrowest-pad trial lost the fewest groups), and set reach to 0 so the fingertip swing stays at stock. No catalogue move other than pads changes the face tilt of the revolute jaw, and the parallelogram and prismatic jaws lose apple and banana on reach or rise.
